reference.verdict: Audit 2026-09-25: verdict **official_api** (confidence medium). AutoScout24 group Listing Creation API is public-doc'd but write-only for registered dealer accounts (create/update listings, images, taxonomy); no search endpoint; RO market coverage not explicitly confirmed.

reason: Upload-only official API (https://listing-creation.api.autoscout24.com/docs): AutoScout24 group Listing Creation API is public-doc'd but write-only for registered dealer accounts (create/update listings, images, taxonomy); no search endpoint; RO market coverage not explicitly confirmed. It manages the account's own adverts (create/update/delete) and has no public listing search, VIN decode or valuation; the automotive vocabulary is read-only (no write verbs), so it is recorded, not served.
